statement: --mtp-exact-sampling is a no-op for our stack. The flag sets dspark_exact_sampling, which only gates the DSPARK branch (opportunistic/stochastic) in ds4_session_eval_speculative; that branch requires support_kind == DS4_SUPPORT_DSPARK. Our support model qwen3.8-flash-next-q4-mtp.gguf is a Qwen4 MTP sidecar (general.architecture=qwen4-exp-mtp, ds4.pack.artifact=mtp) with 32 tensors all under language_model.mtp.* -- it has no DSpark tensors (main_proj/markov_head/confidence_head) and no MTP_LEGACY exact names (mtp.0.e_proj.weight etc.), so support_model_detect classifies it as DS4_SUPPORT_NONE, not MTP_LEGACY and not DSPARK. Our runs use the separate Qwen4 MTP path (confirmed by the #148 log line 'Qwen matching v3 q4_k MTP sidecar loaded ... state=ready draft=7'), which never consults dspark_exact_sampling. So the third arm #142 handed to #39 cannot be run as posed: the flag changes nothing on the Qwen4 path we run.
